transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, what finally made me come in is that I'm having a lot of trouble with, like, small mistakes. I'm 21, just got my bachelor's, and I'm trying to figure out my next steps, but I keep turning in applications or, you know, research notes with these small but really embarrassing errors. Like, I'll mislabel a date on an artwork or just completely skip a question on a form. And the frustrating part is I honestly thought I had checked them before turning them in. It's just... it's happening enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.

Have you noticed this kind of difficulty with small mistakes and losing focus on details going back to childhood or your school years, or is this something that's really only become a problem recently?

Yeah, it's definitely been going on since I was a kid. Even back in elementary school, my teachers would always write on my report cards that I had good ideas, but I'd just... forget to actually turn in my worksheets, or I'd lose the instructions for things. I was always missing those little details. Honestly, it really only got caught back then because my parents had to check my backpack every single night to make sure I was actually doing what I was supposed to. So, yeah, it's not a new thing for me.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things—like your performance, health, or other everyday matters—more days than not, even when there's no clear reason to worry?

No, I wouldn't say I worry like that. I mean, I get frustrated when I mess up an application or something, but it's not this constant, everyday worry about everything. It's just annoyance at the mistakes I make, not a general anxiety.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
No, not really. I haven't been feeling sad or down, and I still enjoy the things I usually do. I'm just mostly annoyed about the mistakes I keep making, but my mood is generally fine.
